mapper.sql: e.id, e.employee_no, e.employee_name, e.employee_name_kana, e.gender, e.employment_type, e.hire_date, e.resign_date, e.email, e.phone, e.workplace_id, e.department_id, w.workplace_name, d.department_name, e.status, CASE WHEN m.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS external_mapping_bound, m.source_system AS external_source_system, m.external_employee_id, m.external_employee_no
mapper.select: SELECT FROM employee e LEFT JOIN workplace w ON w.id = e.workplace_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN employee_external_mapping m ON m.employee_id = e.id AND m.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM employee e LEFT JOIN workplace w ON w.id = e.workplace_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN employee_external_mapping m ON m.employee_id = e.id AND m.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.employee_no = #{employeeNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET workplace_id = #{in.workplaceId}, department_id = #{in.departmentId}, employee_no = #{in.employeeNo}, employee_name = #{in.employeeName}, employee_name_kana = #{in.employeeNameKana}, gender = #{in.gender}, employment_type = #{in.employmentType}, hire_date = #{in.hireDate}, resign_date = #{in.resignDate}, email = #{in.email}, phone = #{in.phone}, status = #{in.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_work_rule ( tenant_id, employee_id, work_rule_type, standard_daily_minutes, standard_weekly_minutes, overtime_enabled, night_work_enabled, holiday_work_enabled, rounding_rule_id, effective_start_date, effective_end_date ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{employeeId}, #{workRuleType}, #{dailyMinutes}, #{weeklyMinutes}, 1, CASE WHEN #{dailyMinutes} >= 480 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{dailyMinutes} >= 480 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, NULL, #{effectiveStartDate}, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE employee_external_mapping SET source_system = #{in.sourceSystem}, external_employee_id = #{in.externalEmployeeId}, external_employee_no = #{in.externalEmployeeNo}, status = #{in.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId}
